pages.text: Fires only $(item)Napalm Potatoes$(): a potato filled with 500 mB of napalm by a spout. On impact it bursts into a shower of fire sparks and an explosion that $(item)breaks blocks$(). It reloads in 75 ticks (under 4 seconds) and has 500 durability. Like Create's cannon, a filled backtank absorbs the wear.

$(l)Quad Potato Cannon$()$(br)Takes the same ammunition as Create's Potato Cannon, but each shot fires $(item)four times$() as many projectiles in a spray, for one ammo item.$(br)Reload time depends on the ammo, as in Create.

It has 100 durability, uses backtank air the same way, and accepts Power, Punch, Flame, Looting and Potato Recovery.$(br2)Both cannons look for ammo anywhere in your inventory. Hold the cannon and read its tooltip to see the damage, reload and knockback of the ammo it will use.
